title: File:Black and white portrait with Helios 44-2 58mm vintage lens (26765638173).jpg
desc:
Took this picture of my coworker Mads Elbrønd with the Helios 44-2 58mm f2 vintage lens (old lens from the Soviet Union). Sure the focus is a bit off, but for the low price and the because of the awesome bokeh, I like it! Love Fuji's manual focus peaking.
Was taken at the Copenhagen Beer Festival 20
